profile.headline: Software Engineer 6 at JACOBS
profile.summary:
A United States citizen that is a productive and dependable Software Development Engineer with over eight years of experience in all phases of the software development life cycle from requirements analysis through production level support. Extensive software design experience in full-stack solutions and using industry standard programming languages Python, SQL and C/C++. I am interested in supporting front and backend application programming interfaces used on aerospace science and technology-based systems for boundless frontier exploration advancing scientific knowledge and helping make research breakthroughs that are not possible on Earth. 

Having built up various web based solutions for small businesses that require client/server side accesses to databases as well as architecting and designing the hardware/software necessary to meet my client's needs has proven to be an equally exciting experience in this ever changing, ever challenging, and ever expanding field of software.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer 6
positions.description: Amentum Technology, a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, help NASA on the Artemis program with a goal to send astronauts on missions to explore more of the moon for scientific discoveries, economic benefits, and to build a foundation for the first crewed missions to Mars.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
seminolecyclists.wildapricot.org is a membership based platform website designed for the premier central Florida cycling group SEMINOLE Cyclists. 

Web Design Engineer (2006-Current)
•	Designed the MySQL database configuration for bike related information that are administered by using phpMyAdmin.
•	Used Photoshop CS4 to create graphics for various art work related to website.
•	Flash content is generated by using combinations of Boris FX Continuum Complete 6.0 and Adobe After Effects CS4 to come up with a colorful and professional touch.
•	Built the static front-end using HTML, PHP, and JavaScript.
•	Programmed the SEMINOLE Cyclists logo using Adobe Illustrator CS4

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
SunFunMedia.com is a website designed for the largest vacation trade company in radio, and is the leading supplier and most trusted source of promotional and incentive travel to the industry. The website has a brochure front end and a client vacation ordering system using PDFlib Personalization server to create variation of PDF documents to clients. Also a database administration backend to add and modify database related information regarding Sun & Fun Media’s clients.

•	Designed the MySQL database configuration for client information containing database tables that are administered by Sun & Fun Media through an administration backend written in PHP with MySQL requests.
•	Created various report mechanisms using PHP and MySQL queries that can be generated for the Sun & Fun Media regarding their database.
•	Built the front-end brochure using HTML, PHP, and JavaScript with a login protected client vacation ordering access. 
•	Implemented an email receipt to the ordering client with a unique attached PDF reservation file with their order information using PDFlib Personalization Server software and Adobe Acrobat.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
JacobsTechnologies helps NASA prepare for the next stage of exploration of the solar system and beyond by designing and developing systems to be used for the ground processing of space launch vehicles, spacecraft, and payloads. Responsible for performing flight systems engineering and support engineering for spaceflight hardware and software; develop technologies that address NASA’s mission requirements and operations needs for the future; operate laboratories, developmental shops, and test facilities; and provide a range of technical services.

•	Collaborated with various project component teams to enhance automated verification test suite for the SLS project using Cucumber 1.3.20, Rake 12.0.0, Rails 4.2.8,  Rspec 3.5.4, Factory Girl 4.8.0, Selenium-WebDriver 2.53.4 and Ruby 2.3.1p112 gem usage to design and run automated tests using RubyMine 8.0 IDE to run on Red Hat Linux 2.6.32-642.15.1.el6.x86_64 platform.
•	Analyze desired features and their effects on the Ruby development team regarding design, performance, documentation, cost and time estimates. Provided data to management for scheduling iterations of work for the Ruby team.
•	Modified and created Ruby language based software for requested elements that help the customer administer all components involved on the project through a Rails web application. 
•	Rails web application   
•	Ruby application interfaced with the database SQLite3.6.16 with sqlite 1.3.12 gem and PostgreSQL PgAdmin3 1.20.0 GUI Client. Database contained 100 different tables and were populated by parsing various customer XML based data in XTCE format and Excel spreadsheets.
•	Worked with system test groups to verify Ruby software is performing as expected.

positions.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
positions.description:
Payment Systems. Using cutting-edge electronic payment technologies, transaction management and security solutions shape the very future of the payment market in North America. Developing software on a Nucleus OS, a real time operating System (RTOS), on ARM 7 and 9 32-bit RISC architecture-based embedded microprocessors providing low power consumption and performance capabilities, these are further enhanced by Nucleus OS’ small foot print and minimal memory needs.

•	Collaborated with offshore teams to architect BDD automated verification test suite from the ground up for the various products offered using Cucumber and Ruby to design and run automated tests using RubyMine IDE to run on various platforms such as Windows 7, Windows XP, Linux, and Mac OS. 
•	Developed Cucumber feature tests and Ruby step definition methods to exercise the product specification requirements on various product lines that verify software updates provide an uncompromising solution. 
•	Wrote test scenarios to reproduce problems found in the field from dropped protocol messaging to memory leak detections using Cucumber/Ruby based scripting.
•	Architected web project management application and server requirements to allow various user roles to view, report, query, and archive test run data for projects being exercised with a Cucumber based test suite. 
•	Provided training on Cucumber design to various company teams to introduce how Cucumber behavior driven development is used for testing, demoing, and certifying the various product lines.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: The SEMINOLE Cyclists organization is a cycling club of 750+members strong and growing. I have been a member since 2004 and took the vice president position in 2007 to help direct the goals and procedural matters as well as shape and oversee organizational principles are advanced. Our club is a non-profit cycling club that is involved in more than just cycling. Our widely diverse group comes from all backgrounds and supports the local community in various projects: Adopt-A-Road cleanups, Boys and Girls Club of Central Florida, American Diabetes Association of Central Florida, Youth Scholarship Program in association with the J. Douglas Williams YMCA Family Center, Safe House of Seminole County, Young Survival Coalition - Cancer Related Research for Young Women, Livestrong Foundation - Cancer Research, Homes for our Troops.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A400M. Astronautics provides airborne computer system for A400M airbus. The system consists of dual Integrated Network Server Units (INSU), a Portable Maintenance Access Terminal (PMAT), an Airborne Maintenance Access Terminal (AMAT), Cockpit Printer, and Personal Identification Reader system.  Each of the two INSU's hosts a Power PC CPU with a Real Time Operating System Green Hills INTEGRITY®-178B RTOS Level C and a Pentium CPU with an Astronautics Linux Operating System, together with two 128 GB solid state memory units.  System interface capabilities include AFDX, Ethernet, ARINC-429 (80 Rx), analog, discrete, serial.
 
•	Wrote existing high and low level test cases and procedures using DOORS in support of the A400M requirements in regards to avionics messaging interacting with various interface protocols such as ARINC-429 and AFDX. 
•	Used configuration tools Tortoise SubVersion and Merant Tracker to maintain traceability for meeting DO-178B Level C Certification.
•	Wrote test applications using C/C++, Python, and Linux scripting for embedded secure centralized interface for ARINC-429 and AFDX protocols on Green Hills INTEGRITY®-178B RTOS and integrated into system to verify system meeting requirements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
BRITE Star (BS) is an advanced laser designator/rangefinder thermal imaging system designed for both maritime patrol and attack craft. The controller cards used for handling the device’s processing functions uses a MPC8260 PowerQUICC based processor using VxWorks real-time OS. Board applications are written in C++ with WindRiver’s Tornado compiler, Silicon Laboratories, Code Composer, and the Dunfield 8051 compiler. Simulation applications are written in Visual Studio2010. These applications are used for testing the various protocols such as USMC 1553, RS-422, CAAS Ethernet, and GPS NMEA interfacing to the BRITE Star device.

•	Wrote requirements, designed specifications, implemented and tested the pulse-repetition frequency (PRF) and passive intermodulation (PIM) code laser related features such as laser designators, laser range finders, and laser spot trackers.
•	Updated and generated PC Visual Studio 2010 simulation applications that transmit/receive command/response messages from the BRITE Star device for various protocol simulations such as CAN, USMC 1553, RS-422, CAAS/Ethernet, and GPS NMEA.
•	Added CAN protocol messaging applications for interfacing between various boards on the BRITE Star device.
•	Created Code Composer DSP software for TI-2812 that is used to manage camera, imaging, and laser devices located on the turret of the BRITE Star device.
•	Involved in software configuration management using AccuRev, engineering support using HP Quality Center, DOORS, and Test Directory for tracking requirements, bugs, and quality control.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Remote Minehunting Vehicle (RMV) is a long endurance; high-efficiency propulsive 23-ft.-long (7m) vehicle that features a forward-looking sonar for detection and avoidance of underwater objects. The controller cards used for handling the vehicle’s processing functions uses a MPC8260 PowerQUICC II based processor using VxWorks real-time operating system to handle OS functions and applications developed using the C++ and C programming languages with WindRiver’s Tornado development environment. The development platform is SUN Workstations using Solaris x86 and SunOS.

•	Coded resolutions to C++ and C source code during integration test phase of the RMV.
•	Investigated object oriented C++ and C software problems.
•	Executed software calibration systems that interface with mechanical parts of RMV using UNIX platform based software control systems.
•	Resolved RMV’s VxWorks RTOS based software problems.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Alcatel 7340 Packet Optical Line Terminal provides concentration and switching functionality between the network and the passive optical networking (PON) interfaces. The Alcatel 7340 P-OLT works in conjunction with the Alcatel 7340 Home Optical Network Terminal (H-ONT) to provide a complete optical access solution. The line termination card for the P-OLT uses a MPC8260 PowerQUICC II based processor using VxWorks operating system to handle OS functions and applications. The development environment is SUN Workstations using Solaris x86 and SunOS based platform.

•	Converted Intel’s I960/pSOS based line termination card to a Motorola’s MPC8260 PowerQUICC II/VxWorks platform.
•	Coded C++ for infrastructure layer using Green Hills compiler/linker on Solaris x86 IDE and Sun workstations.
•	Completed design documents, develop and perform unit tests on infrastructure layer of the network termination software.
•	Used proprietary MIB Browser, simulators, TL1 interfaces, Green Hills Multi Source Level Debugger, serial port communications, and GNU debugger in testing software used for the line termination boards and their PON interfaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accession Next Generation Digital Loop Carrier is a carrier class access/DSLAM platform delivering Broadband (data) and Narrowband (voice) through a single loop pair. Accession enables voice over a digital subscriber loop such that the data services are to be deployed through a configurable shelf. The OAM function for the shelf is provided through an embedded SNMP protocol agent. The development platform is Wind River Tornado II running on a Windows NT operating system and the target platform is a VxWorks operating system running on a Motorola PPC860 processor.

•	Led the design of the SNMP based management interface for the Accession digital subscriber line access multiplexer product, which was coded using C on a Windows NT development platform using the Wind River Tornado II IDE.
•	Specified the design and performed the C implementation of the memory management and inter-task communication used by the embedded SNMP protocol agent targeted for the Motorola Power PC 860 processor.  
•	Defined the initialization, the authentication, and the MIB object handling processes used by the SNMP protocol agent to properly handle packet data requests and responses for both University of Cal-Davis’ and SNMP Research’s SNMP protocol agent.
•	Prioritized telephony features for each software release in regards to configuring and administrating the Accession product via the SNMP network management protocols.
•	Supported front-end user interface designed using Agranat’s embedded web server EmWeb. Created several EmWeb HTML pages that allow network management to enter SNMP authentication and trap destination IP addresses via the HTML protocol interface.
•	Supplied estimates for telephony feature designs and status to management and assisted in product scheduling.
